svg.title: dsh-baton MCP tools
svg.desc: Listed: list workspaces, list sessions, read session, send, status, wait, answer, cancel, call. Less used, reached through dsh_call: create and rename workspace, session activity, rename session, update queued, list runs.

text.font-family: "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 列出 9 个工具，另外 6 个经 dsh_call 调用
